observation: Tool-server records from the attempt associated with each scored output. A successful call means the tool server recorded ok=true; it does not establish client receipt or comprehension.
index_definition: Zero-based position in the full tool-call sequence, including unsuccessful calls. Null means the event was not observed.
window_definition: Events strictly after the first successful test-path read and strictly before the first successful write of any file; use trace end when no write occurs. An empty window is not evidence of premature stopping.
path_normalization: Remove a leading repo/ before testing path membership. Reading a path may cover only a requested line range.

event_records.paths: Path classification table; each path_id is local to one run and preserves path equality without publishing file contents or path strings.
event_records.path_id: Run-local identifier for a normalized path.
event_records.is_test: Whether the normalized path matches test_path_rule; a structural proxy, not a semantic relevance label.
event_records.is_changed_production: Whether the normalized path is in the episode production-file set.
event_records.is_recorded_test: Whether the normalized path is a recorded developer test target for this episode.
event_records.events: All recorded tool calls in their original sequence.
event_records.operation: read: read_file or repo_context_read_file; write: write_file or repo_context_write_file; search: search or repo_context_search; other: any remaining tool.
event_records.ok: Recorded tool-server success flag; only boolean true counts as successful.
event_records.path_ids: Paths mentioned by call arguments and, for search calls, returned matches. Search matches and failed reads are not successful reads.

top_level.cohort: Number of positive episodes, agent conditions, and paired records.
top_level.records_ok: Number of available records included in the extraction.
top_level.missing_traces: Agent/episode pairs without available trace records.
top_level.trace_metrics: Counts of records satisfying the corresponding file-access condition, recomputed from records.
top_level.records: One file-access summary per agent/episode pair.

record_fields.tool_call_count: All recorded tool calls, including unsuccessful calls.
record_fields.first_production_diff_read: First successful read of input/prod.diff; null if absent.
record_fields.first_changed_production_file_read: First successful read of a changed production path; null if absent.
record_fields.first_test_file_read: First successful read of a path matching test_path_rule; null if absent.
record_fields.first_recorded_test_file_read: First successful read of a recorded developer test target; null if absent.
record_fields.first_write: First successful write to any file; null if absent.
record_fields.direct_changed_production_file_count: Distinct changed production paths successfully read.

exploration_fields.event_count: All tool calls in the window, including unsuccessful calls.
exploration_fields.read_count: Successful file-read events in the window.
exploration_fields.search_count: Search calls in the window, including unsuccessful calls.
exploration_fields.distinct_path_count: Distinct paths mentioned by window calls, including search results and paths in unsuccessful calls.
exploration_fields.new_distinct_path_count: Paths successfully read in the window that were not successfully read before or at the first test read.
exploration_fields.changed_production_path_count: New paths in the episode production-file set.
